name: Gokko Vol. 03 Etcetera
source:
"Etcetera" describes quite well the content of this game, which is the third volume in the Gokko series. While the two previous games were dedicated to certain themes or scenarios (doctor and school girls, respectively), the third one is a collection of multi-thematic stories of a sexual nature. The protagonist is a young Japanese male (default name Shouhei), and his first objective is to seduce his boss's sexy sister. In following chapters, the hero encounters other women (sports car driver, journalist, etc.), each encounter ending the way one would expect from a bishoujo game.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/gokko-vol-03-etcetera]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
“其他种种”恰好概括了《Gokko》系列第三卷的内容。前两作分别围绕特定主题或场景展开——医生与女学生——第三作则是收录多个主题的情色故事合集。主角是一名年轻日本男子（默认名为翔平），最初的目标是诱惑老板性感的妹妹。在后续章节中，他还会遇见其他女性，例如跑车车手、记者等，而每次邂逅都会以美少女游戏玩家意料之中的方式收场。

[引自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/gokko-vol-03-etcetera]Moby Games[/url]]
